column7: LocalStorage.UpdateProject was a bare GORM Save, so a plain project RENAME whose read predated an admin enabling ADR-037's per-project require_mfa wrote `false` back over it -- silently disabling the per-project MFA requirement. The caller needs no roles.assign (only the rename route's own permission), and no audit event is written, because core.UpdateProject only audits when ITS OWN requireMFA argument differs from the value it read -- which it does not when the argument is nil. Fixed by UpdateProjectFields, a conditional column-scoped UPDATE that keeps requireMFA a POINTER all the way to the SET list, so "I am not changing this flag" never reaches the UPDATE. Red on real Postgres: require_mfa was false after a rename raced a successful enable. Found by C-GUARD-3 guard 1
